hints.title: Prefix Sum Formulation
hints.text: Compute prefix sums to answer range sum queries in constant time.

hints.title: Left Boundary Identification
hints.text: For each index i, determine start as the maximum of zero and i - nums[i].

hints.title: Range Accumulation
hints.text: Sum the subarray slice from start to i and add it to the running total.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def subarraySum(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        from itertools import accumulate
        pref = list(accumulate(nums, initial=0))
        ans = 0
        for i, x in enumerate(nums):
            start = max(0, i - x)
            ans += pref[i + 1] - pref[start]
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Constructs prefix sums once then evaluates each index in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating each subarray directly takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Linear auxiliary storage enables constant time range sum queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies prefix sum array to perform rapid interval summation.
